title: Tentative · Friday · French, gym and a small arts share
arrival: This is our working plan. We may adjust it to finish learning well.
note: Tentative plan for October 13–16: LST times and laptop bookings are unconfirmed. Adjust blocks when the new LST timetable arrives. No inequalities upload is required. Begin factors and factor pairs; introduce prime and composite numbers only when ready. Continue Nevermoor from the actual class bookmark. Mr. Eckert teaches French only; Mr. Wyatt teaches PHE. Monday October 12 is Thanksgiving: no school. Confirm soccer playday coverage; leave familiar activities and the actual novel bookmark for any covering teacher.

blocks.title: Arrival and attendance
blocks.notes: Attendance before form collection. Collect routine forms afterward; preview tentative day.
studentSteps: Answer attendance, then hand in any forms.
Look at today’s plan and get paper and a pencil ready.

blocks.title: Maths · factors check and reflection
blocks.notes: Use a short check on factor pairs for 20 and 24; explain how to know the list is complete. Reteach or extend from the check. No upload required.
blocks.firstAction: Find whole-number pairs that multiply to make 12.
studentSteps: Build or draw an array and name its factor pair.
Find other factor pairs for the number.
Show how you checked your list.

blocks.title: Core French · Mr. Eckert
blocks.notes: French-only specialist block with Mr. Eckert; this is Mr. Wyatt’s prep. Classroom health learning and PE are taught by Mr. Wyatt.
blocks.firstAction: Get your French materials ready and follow Mr. Eckert’s directions.
blocks.firstActionKo: 프랑스어 준비물을 꺼내고 Eckert 선생님의 안내를 따르세요.

blocks.title: Snack and gym transition
blocks.notes: Friday snack follows recess; transition to gym by 11:10.
blocks.firstAction: Have your snack and tidy your space.

blocks.title: Physical and Health Education · gym
blocks.notes: Choose a familiar cooperative passing/target activity after checking space, equipment and access. Warm up, practise controlled movements at a suitable distance, then play a short challenge and cool down. Adjust equipment, distance or role so everyone participates.
blocks.firstAction: Listen to the safety directions and choose a way to join.
studentSteps: Practise a controlled pass or target movement.
Help everyone get an active turn.
Name one action that helped the group.
blocks.firstActionKo: 안전 수칙을 듣고 참여할 방법을 고르세요.

blocks.title: Lunch
blocks.notes: Usual intermediate routine: outside 11:50–12:12; transition 12:12–12:13; eating 12:13–12:35.
blocks.firstAction: Follow our outside-play and lunch routine.
blocks.firstActionKo: 바깥 놀이와 점심시간에는 정해진 순서대로 하세요.

blocks.title: Quiet individual time
blocks.notes: Preserve a calm reset; a quiet non-reading choice is available.
blocks.firstAction: Choose quiet reading, drawing or an unfinished task.
blocks.firstActionKo: 조용히 책 읽기, 그림 그리기, 끝내지 못한 활동 중 하나를 고르세요.

blocks.title: Art · continue and finish existing artwork
blocks.notes: Continue existing art first, or use only the visual-art page of Four Arts Foundations. Demonstrate two original thumbnails with different emphasis, then let students make a small study using line, shape, colour or value. Partners say what they notice first; the artist revises one choice or explains why it works. Keep inquiry content accurate and assess the artistic choice separately.
blocks.firstAction: Choose a work in progress, or sketch two ways to show one idea.
studentSteps: Make or continue one small visual study.
Ask what a viewer notices first.
Revise one choice and explain its effect.
blocks.titleKo: 미술 · 표현 방법 고르고 간단히 소개하기
blocks.firstActionKo: 만들던 작품을 고르거나, 한 가지 생각을 표현할 두 가지 방법을 스케치하세요.

blocks.title: Planners, jobs and cleanup
blocks.notes: Keep routine cleanup around 2:00; move unfinished learning forward. Send home interim reports by today.
blocks.firstAction: Restore our room and record any confirmed reminders.
blocks.firstActionKo: 교실을 정리하고 확정된 안내 사항을 적으세요.

blocks.title: Classroom community
blocks.notes: Use a short check-in, appreciation or familiar cooperative game. Students may speak, draw, point or pass; keep feedback specific and avoid public rankings.
blocks.firstAction: Notice one helpful action from today.
studentSteps: Offer one specific appreciation or listen.
Name a small next step for tomorrow.
blocks.firstActionKo: 오늘 도움이 된 행동 한 가지를 떠올려 보세요.

blocks.title: Pack up and dismissal
blocks.firstAction: Check your belongings and get ready for a calm departure.
blocks.firstActionKo: 자기 물건을 확인하고 차분히 하교할 준비를 하세요.

backups: If laptops are unavailable, finish paper work, rehearse a spoken reflection or plan the next Action Pack step.
Carry unfinished learning into the next suitable block. No inequalities upload is required.
LST times will be added when confirmed.
